scope: Digital dual-clock RTL, shared reset epochs and generic netlist structure; no analog metastability/MTBF or physical signoff

commands.name: w8-d2-synthesis
argv: read_verilog -sv "/work/labs/24-async-fifo/async_fifo.sv"; chparam -set DATA_W 8 -set ADDR_BITS 1 async_fifo; synth -top async_fifo; check -assert; select -assert-none t:$dlatch; write_json w8-d2.json
